rolesReference.title: Roles explained
rolesReference.enforcementNotice: Right now the system enforces two levels: Owner/Manager (can edit restaurant settings and staff) and any active staff member (day-to-day reservations and tables). The distinctions below are team conventions for now, not yet enforced by the database.
rolesReference.owner: Full access, including staff, restaurant settings and (later) billing.
rolesReference.manager: Same day-to-day access as an owner: restaurant settings, staff, reservations, tables.
rolesReference.reservation_manager: Intended to manage reservations, waitlist and events without touching staff or restaurant settings.
rolesReference.host: Intended to run the floor: seat guests, update table status, take walk-ins.
rolesReference.staff: Intended for day-to-day reservation and table work without administrative access.
